feature.summary: The indexer cuts project files, library files, chats, artifacts, reports and developer sessions into overlapping text chunks and stores them with a text-search column and, when possible, an embedding vector. Embedding is a metered call. If it fails, chunks stay keyword-searchable and indexing retries with growing delays. A cron sweep every ten minutes starts the work.

purpose.what_it_does: Claims a pending retrieval document, loads its source text, cuts it into 1,400-character windows with 200 overlap (max 400 chunks), embeds the chunks in metered batches, writes chunks and settles the document status in one transaction (apps/web/lib/services/retrieval-index-service.ts:417-436,479-518,658-785; packages/platform/data-layer/src/search/chunk.ts:10-15).
purpose.why_it_exists: Search by meaning and by keyword needs a prepared copy of the content; 0202 says nothing was embedded before so there was no semantic or hybrid retrieval on managed cloud (apps/web/db/neon/0202_retrieval_index.sql:6-10).
purpose.who_uses_it: The platform runs it in the background; people see only index status on project files.
problems_solved: Large files that cannot be sent whole.
Search that matched only titles and messages (0202:6-8).
A failed embedding losing the content: chunks are still stored for keyword (retrieval-index-service.ts:496-512).
Duplicate work: unchanged text costs nothing (lines 700-717).
use_cases: A new project file is indexed within ten minutes.
A chat is re-indexed after it changes.
A failed file is retried by the person with 'Retry indexing'.
A file restored after deletion is indexed again.

where_to_find_it: Web: Projects, knowledge files list: status 'Indexing for search', 'Keyword search only', 'Not indexed', and 'Retry indexing' for failed files (KnowledgeIndexStatus.tsx:28-70; KnowledgeFilesPanel.tsx:125).
No status or retry for chats, library files, artifacts or reports was found. unknown.
Other apps: no indexing control found.
prerequisites: A source saved on the Cloud service; for semantic indexing a managed embedding route and managed compute access.
screens_and_controls: Index status line per knowledge file; 'Retry indexing' link shown when status is failed (KnowledgeIndexStatus.tsx:56-71).
journey: The person adds a project file or chats.
A database trigger creates or marks the retrieval document (0202 header lines 26-30).
Within about ten minutes the cron sweep reserves it and starts a workflow (vercel.json:62-63; route.ts:25-33).
The file list shows status until indexed; a failed file shows the reason and 'Retry indexing'.
The person can press 'Retry indexing', which posts to the reindex route.
feedback_and_outputs: Status text and error messages such as 'Semantic indexing needs managed compute on your plan or workspace; keyword search still works.' (retrieval-index-service.ts:104-117).
202 response with indexing state and 'dispatched' flag from the reindex route.
settings: None for the person. Operator: cron route and low-power skip (route.ts:21-22).

working: Chunking with paragraph and sentence boundary search (chunk.ts:17-47).
Per-kind source loaders for project files, library files, chats, artifacts, reports and developer sessions (retrieval-index-service.ts:240-410, partly read).
Metered embedding in batches with reservation and settle (retrieval-embedding-service.ts:204-333).
Failure keeps chunks and retries: 5-minute base doubling to 24 hours, 6 hours for no route or not entitled, max 5 attempts (retrieval-index-service.ts:39,48-49,452-454,720-724).
Run fenced to the claiming workflow id, so a stale run writes nothing (lines 520-540,745-753).
Cron sweep every 10 minutes, 50 documents per sweep, skip on low power (vercel.json:62-63; retrieval-index-service.ts:790-815; route.ts:21-33).
incomplete: After five failed attempts the sweep no longer picks the document up; only 'Retry indexing' for project files resets attempts (retrieval-index-service.ts:803-806,868-880). No equivalent control for other kinds was found.
disconnected_or_disabled: 0202 header: NOT YET APPLIED : draft only; apply state unknown.
not_available: No on-device indexing: the index is built on our servers for every app. CLI, VS Code and Chrome extension do not build or query it (none found).

established.statement: Documents are split into chunks for indexing.
Chunks get embeddings generated (metered) for semantic search.
A chunk written without an embedding is still found by full text.
Embedding usage is reserved and settled through the managed usage ledger.
Sources soft-deleted, temporary or archived leave the index.

acceptance_criteria: A new project file gets a retrieval_documents row and, after the sweep, status indexed with chunk_count > 0.
If embedding fails, chunks exist with null embeddings, status failed, last_error set and next_attempt_at in the future.
After 5 failures the sweep does not pick it up; 'Retry indexing' resets attempts to 0.
Unchanged text and existing embeddings cause no new embedding call.
A deleted source removes its document and chunks.
Every embedding call writes a reservation and a settlement.
inferred: Free accounts index by keyword always and semantically within managed access [inferred from the failure messages].
proposed: [proposed] Offer retry and status for chats and library files.
[proposed] Alert when a document hits the attempt limit.

steps.what_happens: A trigger on the source table enqueues or marks stale a retrieval document.
Cron reserves due documents (holds them 15 minutes) and starts index workflows.
The step claims the document, loads source text, windows it and hashes it.
Embedding call reserves usage, calls the gateway or Google embeddings, settles the cost.
One transaction settles the document and rewrites chunks.

data.what: retrieval_documents state and retrieval_chunks (text, offsets, tsvector, 1536-number vector)
data.where_stored: cloud database, row-level security by owner
data.retained_or_deleted: Cascade delete with the source; deleted when source is soft-deleted or temporary; archive removal via 0244 (draft).

data.where_stored: managed usage ledger and COGS ledger

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: The embedding model comes from routing slot embedding_default; routes must use the vercel_gateway/embeddings or google/embeddings harness and a credentialed managed provider (retrieval-embedding-service.ts:48,68-73,96-115). Providers: provider:vercel-gateway, provider:google. Google-user-data text is limited to providers that keep inputs out of training (lines 215-220).

access_and_usage.account: Signed in owner; the workflow runs under a user-scoped database (index-retrieval-document.ts:36-41).
access_and_usage.permissions: Owner must own the source (0202:159-207 policies).
access_and_usage.subscription: Free plan is allowed managed compute (managed-compute-access.ts:55) and has a 200 queries/day cap for query embeddings only; document embedding has no daily cap in this code. Paid plans: no cap in this rule (billing-catalog.ts:737-739). Reservation and entitlement can still refuse: code not_entitled or billing_refused.
access_and_usage.limits_and_metering: Max 400 chunks, 200,000 source characters, 400 chat messages, 50 documents per sweep, 5 attempts (retrieval-index-service.ts:39-48). A quota read failure lets the call through (tier-unit-quota-service.ts:391-405).
access_and_usage.model_compatibility: Vector width fixed at 1536; a different width needs a migration and full re-index (types.ts:12-17; 0202:130).
access_and_usage.provider_restrictions: Needs a managed embedding provider; none means keyword only with message 'Semantic indexing is not configured on this deployment; keyword search still works.'
access_and_usage.local_mode: No Local indexing exists. Local-mode content is not indexed by this feature; chat and project content saved to Cloud is indexed and embedded on our servers, using managed compute regardless of the chat's mode.

scenarios.name: New file indexed
steps: Add a text file to a project.
Wait for the sweep or trigger the cron route with the cron secret.

scenarios.name: Embedding down
scenarios.expected: Chunks exist with null embedding; status failed; last_error says keyword search still works; retry in 6 hours.

scenarios.name: Retry
steps: Open a failed file and press Retry indexing.
scenarios.expected: 202 with dispatched true; attempts reset to 0.

scenarios.name: Edit
scenarios.expected: Document goes stale, new chunk_version, old chunks replaced.

scenarios.name: Give up
scenarios.expected: Sweep stops picking it; only manual retry resumes.

diagnostics: Logs '[retrieval] embedding failed; chunks are stored for keyword search only', '[retrieval] chunk write failed', 'Retrieval index sweep failed'.

corrections.claim: Free plan is allowed managed compute (managed-compute-access.ts:55)
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The Free-tier allow is at line 74 (isFreePlanTier returns SUBSCRIPTION_ALLOWED), not 55. Also this is only the subscription half; evaluateManagedComputeAccess then runs a workspace access check that can still refuse.
corrections.correction: Free plan passes the subscription check (managed-compute-access.ts:74), but workspace policy (:191) can still refuse.

corrections.claim: 0202 header: NOT YET APPLIED, draft only; apply state unknown
corrections.what_the_code_shows: The header text does say NOT YET APPLIED, but it is a stale comment. Migrations form an applied, append-only checksummed chain far beyond 0202 (production is at 0425 per project notes and AGENTS.md), so 0202 and 0244 are applied in the chain. 'Unknown' and the Gap row 'not established as applied' overstate the doubt.
corrections.correction: The 0202/0244 headers still say NOT YET APPLIED but are stale; later migrations are applied past them. Check migration tracking to confirm, but treat as applied.

missing_facts: Only the cron sweep (route.ts:25-33) and the reindex route start indexing; the workflow step runs under createClaimedUserScopedDb with the owner's userId and organizationId (apps/web/lib/workflows/steps/index-retrieval-document.ts:38-45), so organization/workspace policy applies to indexing, not just individual accounts.

Embedding input is truncated per text (MAX_EMBEDDING_INPUT_CHARS) and each call is capped at MAX_EMBEDDING_INPUTS, with a no-training provider filter applied when the user opted out of side-call training (retrieval-embedding-service.ts:210-220); the page mentions only Google user data.

A document is dispatch-held for 15 minutes (DISPATCH_HOLD_MINUTES) at reservation, separate from the 10-minute lease (retrieval-index-service.ts:50-51,790-815); the page notes both but never explains that a failed workflow start waits up to 15 minutes, not 10, for retry.
